review: The damage dealer of rupture. Instead of maintaining rupture she focuses on having high clash power and damage boasting from 10/16/17 to a whopping 14/22/17, Unfortunately her s3 does not gain any coin power boost instead it gets a dmg boost depending on the amount of rupture on target. All of this in exchange of having negative rupture count on both s1 and s3 while s2 being neutral count meaning you’re gonna have to pay attention to the rupture count the enemy has as she can easily demolish them No particular E.G.O Synergies. Due to the fact that Fluid Sac Faust E.G.O. is arguably the best E.G.O. in game, it is always worth having
